verdict.rationale: The firm shows some cross-border venture relevance. Its 2026 Startup Notification analysis covers flip-structure ineligibility, its M&A practice cites FDI/ODI policy, its TMC page addresses investors entering India and start-ups scaling globally, and it is part of the CMS organisation serving multinationals, investors and funds. However, all offices are in India, and the evidence shows no documented cross-border deals or multi-jurisdiction financing work. Missing for 10: documented reverse-flip/redomiciliation advisory or deal track record, concrete multi-jurisdiction financing matters, evidence of coordinated cross-border work with the CMS network, independent corroboration.
